# KS-1232 INFOEMPTY-1 PIN THAT GET /api/connector/info ANSWERS allowedDocumentTypes [] FOR A STORED "", 0 OR false (the three shapes every create refuses) — Wednesday's task for Ornith, TEST_ONLY, **ONE existing test file, one hunk, one cell added, no product file** (written 23:5x on 2026-09-20, widened sweep round 26)

File: `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/ks480-connector-auth.test.ts`
Tip: `dc061f2bb6dff9180a0724b1d1d5c50b9a0173fa`
Runner: `vitest`

Written from develop `dc061f2bb6dff9180a0724b1d1d5c50b9a0173fa` (`git -C "/Volumes/DevMASTER/!CODING/Secuura/Blockchain/2_Project_Files" ls-remote origin refs/heads/develop` at 23:4x on 2026-09-20, read verbs only; the #1101 merge, 2026-09-20 17:53:42 +1000). The test file at that tip is **135 lines**, read whole; its full content is in `files[...]` of your input. The product the cell pins is `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/services/health.ts` (**237 lines**, read whole): `createHealthRoutes` at `:29-32`, the `/api/connector/info` route at `:38-62`, the reader at `:58` (`allowedDocumentTypes: connectorConfig.allowedDocumentTypes || [],`). This service runs **VITEST**.

## THE MODE — read this twice

**TEST_ONLY.** Your diff touches EXACTLY ONE file: the test file above, MODIFIED IN PLACE (`--- a/<path>` / `+++ b/<path>`, the path exactly as written above). You never touch `health.ts`, `auth.ts` or any other product file: the behaviour is already what it is at the tip, and this cell PINS it.

## What the cell pins (one paragraph)

KS-1232 reports that `GET /api/connector/info` tells a connector `allowedDocumentTypes: []` (documented as "all types permitted") for a stored `""`, `0` or `false`, while every `POST /api/documents` from that connector is refused 403 since #1035 (KS-1204: a present, non-array allow-list fails closed). The reader is `health.ts:58`, `connectorConfig.allowedDocumentTypes || []`: each of the three stored values is falsy, so `||` answers `[]`. The suite pins none of it: no test file imports `../services/health` at the tip, `connector/info` occurs in **0** test files, and the create-path suite (`ks1204-…test.ts`) pins only the 403. This change adds ONE cell to the connector-auth suite that seeds the real `authenticateToken` caches for one `sk_` key (as the file's own cells do), builds the REAL health router with a redis-like object whose `platform-settings` carries the connector's config, drives `GET /api/connector/info` through the router IN PROCESS (the file's fake req/res, no port, no fetch) once per stored shape, and asserts `[id, allowedDocumentTypes]` is `['platform-s:ext-1', []]` for all three, with `id` as the liveness element (it is only set when the connector principal reached the handler). Every existing cell is unchanged. **It pins TODAY's behaviour and decides nothing about KS-1232** — the ticket's recommendation is "the info reader should answer what the create path enforces, never `[]` and never the raw value"; either fix shape now arrives as a deliberate red in this suite instead of a silent change.

## The exact change — ONE hunk in the test file

The new cell goes at the end of the `describe('KS-480 — sk_ connector auth path', ...)` block opened at `:65`, directly above that block's closing line `});` (`:135`, the file's LAST line and the ONE trailing context line). There is NO leading context: the line above (`:134`, `  });`) stays and is not written. Copy every line byte for byte. Every `+` line is ASCII only. There is no blank line anywhere in the fence. Keep the header exactly as shown. **Your diff MUST begin with the two file-header lines, above the `@@` line: `--- a/Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/ks480-connector-auth.test.ts` then `+++ b/Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/ks480-connector-auth.test.ts`.**

```
@@ -135,1 +135,17 @@
+  it('RED KS-1232: GET /api/connector/info answers allowedDocumentTypes [] for a stored "", 0 or false - the three shapes every create refuses', async () => {
+    const META = { connectorId: 'platform-s:ext-1', scopes: ['documents:write'], organizationId: 'org-1', tenantId: 'ten-1', rateLimit: 100, rateLimitWindow: 60 };
+    apiKeyCache.set('sk_ks1232', { result: META, expiresAt: Date.now() + 60000 });
+    connectorBearerCache.set('sk_ks1232', { token: 'connector.jwt.token', expiresAt: Date.now() + 60000 });
+    const { createHealthRoutes } = await import('../services/health');
+    const answers: unknown[] = [];
+    for (const stored of ['', 0, false]) {
+      const redisLike = { getNotificationSettings: async () => ({ integrations: [{ id: META.connectorId, config: { allowedDocumentTypes: stored } }] }), getRedisClient: () => null };
+      const router = createHealthRoutes({}, redisLike as any);
+      const req = Object.assign(makeReq({ 'x-api-key': 'sk_ks1232' }), { method: 'GET', url: '/api/connector/info' });
+      const res: any = Object.assign(makeRes(), { setHeader: () => undefined });
+      const body = await new Promise<any>((resolve) => { res.json = (b: unknown) => { resolve(b); return res; }; router(req, res, () => resolve({ fellThrough: true })); });
+      answers.push([body.id, body.allowedDocumentTypes]);
+    }
+    expect(answers).toEqual([['platform-s:ext-1', []], ['platform-s:ext-1', []], ['platform-s:ext-1', []]]);
+  });
 });
```

`authenticateToken`, `apiKeyCache` and `connectorBearerCache` are already imported by the file at `:16-20` (`from '../middleware/auth'`), and `makeReq` / `makeRes` are the file's own helpers at `:25` / `:34` — you add NO import. `createHealthRoutes` is loaded by the dynamic `await import('../services/health')` INSIDE the cell (the file's top-level imports are untouched). The cell needs no mock beyond the file's own `vi.stubGlobal('fetch', ...)` at `:23` (never called: both caches are seeded, so neither the security validate nor the auth exchange fetches), no app boot, no port and no database: the router is called as a function with the file's fake req/res.

## Cells

- `infoempty` = `RED KS-1232: GET /api/connector/info answers allowedDocumentTypes [] for a stored "", 0 or false - the three shapes every create refuses`

## Red cells

The cell below is a GENUINE assertion-red: it fails under each tamper and passes at the tip. It is declared here rather than with a red glyph in its title because every `+` line in this diff must be ASCII only.

- RED KS-1232: GET /api/connector/info answers allowedDocumentTypes [] for a stored "", 0 or false - the three shapes every create refuses

## Tampers

Two single-line tampers on the SAME line of `health.ts` (`:58`, which occurs EXACTLY ONCE in the file — counted with `grep -c -F -x`, 1). They are the two shapes a fix to the reader can take: stop coercing (the raw value comes out), or answer "not a list" (the ticket's recommendation). Each `From` is the tip's line at that number, byte for byte, and each `To` is valid TypeScript, so nothing fails to load and no cell reds for the wrong reason.

### NULLISHRAW — the reader stops coercing falsy values: "", 0 and false come out raw
File: `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/services/health.ts`
Line: 58
From:
```
      allowedDocumentTypes: connectorConfig.allowedDocumentTypes || [],
```
To:
```
      allowedDocumentTypes: connectorConfig.allowedDocumentTypes ?? [],
```
Reds: `infoempty`

### NOTALIST — the reader answers null for a present, non-array allow-list (the ticket's fix shape)
File: `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/services/health.ts`
Line: 58
From:
```
      allowedDocumentTypes: connectorConfig.allowedDocumentTypes || [],
```
To:
```
      allowedDocumentTypes: Array.isArray(connectorConfig.allowedDocumentTypes) ? connectorConfig.allowedDocumentTypes : null,
```
Reds: `infoempty`

## Controls

- `attaches the key scopes + tenant to req.user and the connector bearer to the request`
- `still 401s an invalid key`

*(Both are FULL `it(...)` titles, copied byte for byte from the file at the tip — `:72` and `:121` — each occurs exactly once in the file and neither is a prefix of any other title. For a VITEST suite the checker matches a declared cell by its FULL title, never by a prefix; the prefix rule in `build_test_only_input.sh`'s header is for BASH suites only (the KS-1275 round-1 FAIL, 2026-09-20). The file's other two cells (`:90`, `:106`) are also green under both tampers but are left undeclared. The `:72` control is the liveness proof for the auth half of the new cell: it drives the SAME `authenticateToken(true)` connector branch the new cell rides through, with the same fake req/res shape.)*

## THE CELLS — state it to yourself before you write a line

At the untouched tip the new cell passes: for each stored value the router matches `GET /api/connector/info`, `authenticateToken(true)` finds `sk_ks1232` in `apiKeyCache` (no fetch), builds the connector principal and finds the bearer in `connectorBearerCache` (no fetch), the per-key limiter counts in memory (`getRedisClient()` is null in the test process) and calls `next`; the handler reads `platform-settings` from `redisLike`, finds the integration by `META.connectorId`, and at `:58` evaluates `'' || []`, `0 || []`, `false || []` — all `[]` — beside `id: 'platform-s:ext-1'`. `answers` is `[['platform-s:ext-1', []], ['platform-s:ext-1', []], ['platform-s:ext-1', []]]`, exactly what the cell asserts.

Under **NULLISHRAW** `??` passes the falsy values through: `answers` is `[['platform-s:ext-1', ''], ['platform-s:ext-1', 0], ['platform-s:ext-1', false]]` — assertion red. Under **NOTALIST** none of the three is an array, so every answer is `null`: `[['platform-s:ext-1', null], ...]` — assertion red. Under BOTH, every existing cell stays green: `:72`, `:90`, `:106` and `:121` call `authenticateToken` directly and never load or route through `health.ts`.

## Premises (measured — by reading the tip, NOT by running anything)

- **Premise: the `From` line.** `health.ts` at `dc061f2bb`, line 58 is `      allowedDocumentTypes: connectorConfig.allowedDocumentTypes || [],`, byte for byte; it occurs **exactly once** in the file (`grep -c -F -x`, 1). Both tampers name the same line: the checker plants and restores them one at a time (T8 by sha256 after each).
- **Premise: the ticket's claim, re-derived.** The three stored values are all falsy in JavaScript; `||` at `:58` therefore yields its right operand `[]` for each. The other non-array shapes (a string, an object) are truthy and come out RAW at the tip — that half of the ticket is NOT pinned here (see Notes).
- **Premise: the anchor.** The test file is **135** lines; `:135` is `});` (column 0, the file's last line, the ONLY column-0 `});` in the file, closing the `describe` opened at `:65`) and `:134` is `  });`. The trailing context line is non-blank and the insertion is pure, so no blank line is asked of you anywhere.
- **Premise: nothing pins this today.** `KS-1232`, `connector/info`, `allowedDocumentTypes` and `createHealthRoutes` occur **0** times in the test file at the tip; `git grep -l` for `services/health` / `createHealthRoutes` over `src/` at the tip returns only `index.ts` and `health.ts` themselves — no test imports the health router.
- **Premise: the in-process route call.** `express.Router()` (express `^4.18.2`) is callable as `router(req, res, next)`; the fake req carries `headers`, `get`, `method: 'GET'` and `url: '/api/connector/info'`, which is all the router's matcher and the two handlers read. The fake res gains a no-op `setHeader` because the per-key limiter (`rateLimitEnforce.ts:159-161`) sets `X-RateLimit-*` on every counted response; the file's own cells survive without it only via the limiter's fallback catch. `res.json` is replaced per call so the awaited promise resolves on the handler's answer; a route that falls through resolves `{ fellThrough: true }` and reds by assertion (no `id`).
- **Premise: no `+` line re-adds a tip line.** The only `+` line that also occurs at the tip is the closing `  });` (unavoidable for a new cell); `    }` occurs at the tip only as part of longer lines.
- **No backslash** in any `+` line (0, counted). **No non-ASCII** in any `+` line (0, counted). The title uses `-`, not an em dash; the `""` in the title sits inside a single-quoted string.
- **Premise: the runner.** `api-gateway/package.json` at the tip has `"test": "vitest"` and `vitest ^4.1.9` in devDependencies, with no `jest` / `ts-jest` — the builder auto-detects vitest and the `Runner:` line above agrees with it. `tsconfig.json` excludes `src/__tests__`, so no gate runs tsc on this cell's loose `any`s.
- **Premise: no live-lane collision.** `health.ts` is not `enforcement.ts`, `startup-migrations.ts`, `index.ts` or `trustHeaders.ts`, and is not under `services/anchoring/**`. The previous seat's flag that `health.ts` "carries unmerged READYs (KS-1248, KS-1258)" was measured FALSE: all seven held `READY_KS-1248*` / `READY_KS-1258*` files target `routes/system-status.ts` and its two test files, never `services/health.ts`; every KS-1248/KS-1258 commit (#1039, #1044, #1053, #1068, #1077, #1085) is already in develop's history at the tip; `git log` on `health.ts` at the tip shows its last change was #1037 (KS-1101). No held `READY_*` names `ks480-connector-auth`.
- **Premise: the surface.** The cell constructs a connector principal through the REAL `authenticateToken` (as `:72-118` already do), seeds the two exported caches the file already clears in `beforeEach`, and drives one GET. No user, no session, no MFA state, no product bytes.

None on the product line. The KS-1248 / KS-1258 READYs are all in `routes/system-status.ts` (merged #1039-#1085; the held test-only READYs N44-1/N53-1/N68-1/N68-2/N77-1 touch `ks1248-…` / `ks1258-…` test files). `health.ts:58` has not moved since #1037. Sequencing needed: none.
